payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

check.question: Does the edited image show a chalk-drawing treatment across the scene, including the giraffes and their surroundings?
check.complete_when: The scene as a whole is rendered with a visible chalk-drawing appearance.
check.partial_when: A chalk-drawing treatment is visible on some parts of the scene, but other substantial parts remain photographic or the overall transformation is incomplete.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no chalk-drawing treatment has been applied.
check.unknown_when: The available image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether a chalk-drawing treatment is present.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited scene as a whole—including both giraffes and the surroundings—has a visible chalk-drawing appearance, with softened, grainy strokes replacing the source’s photographic detail."}

parsed.evidence: The edited scene as a whole—including both giraffes and the surroundings—has a visible chalk-drawing appearance, with softened, grainy strokes replacing the source’s photographic detail.
